steps.en: Register the /graphify skill with your AI assistant
steps.zh: 把 skill 注册进你的 AI 助手

steps.en: In the assistant, point it at a folder
steps.zh: 在助手里把目录交给它

steps.en: Parses code locally with tree-sitter ASTs; docs, PDFs and images go through your model for semantic nodes
steps.zh: 本地抽代码 AST，文档图片走模型成语义节点

component.zh: 本地 AST + 语义通道

steps.en: Clusters with Leiden and writes graph.json, an interactive graph.html, and GRAPH_REPORT.md
steps.zh: Leiden 聚类，写出 json、html 和报告

steps.en: Ask structure questions instead of re-reading files
steps.zh: 直接问结构问题，不再重读文件

steps.en: Returns a scoped subgraph where every edge carries an EXTRACTED or INFERRED confidence tag
steps.zh: 返回带 EXTRACTED/INFERRED 置信标签的子图

value.en: An agent answers "what calls this handler" from a portable graph, not by burning context on file dumps
value.zh: agent 从可移植的图里回答“谁调用了它”，不再烧上下文去堆文件
